author: Home
title: 5 Business News Stories You Must Watch Thursday Morning - TheStreet
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Thursday's opening bell :
President Trump said he will launch a national security investigation into car and truck imports under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. Deutsche Bank ( DB ) said it would slash thousands of jobs to reshape operations and cut costs. Elon Musk said he plans to start a website that will let users rate news organizations and the journalists who work for them. Apple ( AAPL ) signed a deal with Volkswagen ( VLKAY ) to turn T6 Transporter vans into self-driving shuttles for employees. U.S. stock futures traded mixed.
